turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's it going? You doing okay?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My in-laws are visiting and I want the guest room to feel welcoming. Any ideas?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fresh sheets, an extra blanket and a couple of clean towels go a long way. A small lamp by the bed is nice too.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I leave some snacks or water in there?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A bottle of water and a little basket of snacks is a lovely touch. Guests often feel shy raiding someone else's kitchen.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What about the wifi password, is it weird to

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not weird at all, it's really helpful. A small card on the nightstand works perfectly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great. Maybe some flowers as well?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure, just pick something without a strong scent in case anyone has allergies.
